packageRules.description: Node stays on 24 until 26 is tested. The node image, node-version in ci.yml and desktop.yml (looked up as actions/node-versions) and @types/node keep the same major, so neither the typechecker nor the image build can rely on what the runtime does not have.
Docker: auto-merge digest pins and digest refreshes (same tag, new build). Major/minor stay open for review.
The compose file is for people to copy, so it follows the app's own latest tag instead of a digest that goes stale every build
